releaseNotes: 修复应用皮肤时偶发无法连接本机灵妆服务的问题；在后台恢复、版本切换或会话清单更新后自动接入当前服务；多 Agent 流程逐步校验连接，确认操作不重复提交，并以 Agent 实际会话状态判断应用结果。
releaseNotesEn: Fixes intermittent local-service connection failures during skin application; reconnects after backend recovery, version handoff, or session-manifest changes; revalidates each multi-agent step; and determines confirmation outcomes from authoritative Agent session state without replaying confirmations.
